# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]

protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.

honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

our patients. As a leader in international healthcare, we deliver the highest quality of care to a
diverse, multinational patient community — combining advanced technology with genuinely personal
attention.

* Multidisciplinary teams of expert physicians
* End-to-end international patient coordination

Book a virtual appointment and get the expert guidance you need—without the commute, the wait, or

## Questions & Answers

#### What Types Of Pain Do You Treat?

We are experts at treating chronic pain at the beginning. We provide treatment for spine pain, back
pain, lower back pain, sciatica, and many other acute and chronic conditions. We also help patients
struggling with migraines, headaches, joint pain, tendonitis, arthritis, bursitis, and more.

#### What Treatment Options Are Available?

We offer a range of innovative treatments, including Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) injections, Stem
Cell Therapy, Regenerative Medicine, spine treatments, and other targeted pain management
injections. Visit our [treatments page][104] for a complete list.

#### Do You Treat Sports Injuries Or Accident-Related Pain?

Yes, we provide care and treatment options to all patients who have chronic pain. Our clinic
supports athletes with sports injuries, car accident patients, and individuals recovering from
painful injuries and disabilities.

#### Do You Provide Pain Management Services On Lien?

We offer treatment on a medical lien basis for patients who are represented by legal counsel. If you
have a client or would like to schedule an appointment, [click here][105].

#### Do You Accept Insurance Or Cash Payments?

Yes, we accept insurance, cash pay, and offer CareCredit financing. If you need help understanding
payment options, our team is here to walk you through it.

## What Patients Ask Us Most

Living with chronic pain often comes with uncertainty. Choosing the right pain management provider
starts with understanding your options. At Advanced Pain Medical Group, we believe informed patients
make confident decisions about their care.

From treatment options to appointment expectations, patients naturally have questions before taking
the next step. These frequently asked questions address the topics we’re asked about most—so you can
feel more comfortable, prepared, and supported from your very first visit.

# Pain Management In Los Angeles
# & Southern California

Advanced Pain Medical Group provides expert, physician-led pain management treatment for spine,
neck, and back conditions.
Our pain management specialists proudly serve new patients throughout Los Angeles & Southern
California.

## Get In Touch
* [ (818) 348-7246 ][68]
* [ Clinic Locations ][69]
* [ Treatments ][70]

## Find Real, Effective Pain Relief

Our board-certified pain specialists bring decades of experience in treating [complex
conditions][71] with a patient-first approach. We focus on accurate diagnosis, [customized treatment
plans][72], and minimally invasive solutions. Patients choose us because we offer:
* Advanced Treatments that target the root cause of your pain.
* Personalized Care Plans built around your health goals and lifestyle.
* A focus on results & long-term recovery, not just short-term relief.

Experience the difference compassionate, expert-driven pain management can make at Advanced Pain
Medical Group. We have [several convenient locations][73] across Los Angeles County, Ventura County,
and Kern County, California to serve you. 

[Advanced Pain Medical Group Logo]

## Compassionate, Effective, Less Invasive

## Explore Treatment Options

[ View Treatments ][74]

### [ Locations ][75]

Get expert care in West Hills, or at one of our locations in Southern California.

### [ Patient Info ][76]

Helpful information, including insurances & referrals, for patients.

### [ Message Us ][77]

We are happy to answer all of your questions. We love to hear from you.

### [ Referrals ][78]

We accept referrals from primary care providers and specialists.

## Meet The Team

## Our Providers

Advanced Pain Medical Group was founded by Dr. Paul B. Johnson and Dr. Vimal S. Lala. As
anesthesiologists and pain medicine physicians, Dr. Johnson and Dr. Lala were fellowship trained at
the premier pain medicine program in the country, UCLA.

Our physicians and medical team are highly regarded specialists with extensive experience, having
collectively performed tens of thousands of interventional pain procedures that have meaningfully
improved lives. As a physician-owned practice with over 20 years of continuous operation, APMG is
known for clinical excellence, consistency, and trusted patient outcomes, treating the whole body by
relieving both acute and chronic pain.

[Dr. Vimal Lala D.o Apmg]

#### Dr. Vimal S. Lala

Double Board-Certified in Anesthesiology and Interventional Pain Management

Residency in Anesthesiology at the Cleveland Clinic Foundation

Fellowship in Interventional Pain Medicine at UCLA

## Pain Management Clinics in Los Angeles

Our network of pain management clinics makes it easy to access expert care throughout Southern
California. With locations in West Hills, Beverly Hills, Valencia, Culver City, Long Beach, Burbank,
Cerritos, and Bakersfield, patients can receive advanced, minimally invasive treatment close to
home.

We treat a full range of conditions, including [back pain][82], [sciatica][83], [neck pain][84],
[joint pain][85], [arthritis][86], [neuropathy][87], and chronic pain disorders.

We use evidence‑based procedures such as [epidural injections][88], [nerve blocks][89], [stellate
ganglion blocks,][90] [radiofrequency ablation][91], and [regenerative therapies][92]. Each clinic
is staffed by board‑certified pain specialists who tailor every treatment plan to your unique needs.

Whether you’re seeking relief from a long‑term condition or recovering from a recent injury, our
pain management clinics across Los Angeles and surrounding regions provide compassionate, effective
care designed to restore mobility and improve your quality of life.

Get expert care at one of our [locations in Southern California.][93]

## Virtual Appointments Offered

Book a virtual appointment and get the expert guidance you need—without the commute, the wait, or
the hassle. Connect face-to-face from wherever you are, get answers fast, and move forward with
confidence. Telehealth is convenient, personal, and designed to fit your schedule. Secure your spot
today and take the first step toward a solution that actually works for you.

[ Call Us ][103]
[Advanced Pain Medical Group Logo]

## Questions & Answers

#### What Types Of Pain Do You Treat?

We are experts at treating chronic pain at the beginning. We provide treatment for spine pain, back
pain, lower back pain, sciatica, and many other acute and chronic conditions. We also help patients
struggling with migraines, headaches, joint pain, tendonitis, arthritis, bursitis, and more.

#### What Treatment Options Are Available?

We offer a range of innovative treatments, including Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) injections, Stem
Cell Therapy, Regenerative Medicine, spine treatments, and other targeted pain management
injections. Visit our [treatments page][104] for a complete list.

#### Do You Treat Sports Injuries Or Accident-Related Pain?

Yes, we provide care and treatment options to all patients who have chronic pain. Our clinic
supports athletes with sports injuries, car accident patients, and individuals recovering from
painful injuries and disabilities.

#### Do You Provide Pain Management Services On Lien?

We offer treatment on a medical lien basis for patients who are represented by legal counsel. If you
have a client or would like to schedule an appointment, [click here][105].

#### Do You Accept Insurance Or Cash Payments?

Yes, we accept insurance, cash pay, and offer CareCredit financing. If you need help understanding
payment options, our team is here to walk you through it.

## What Patients Ask Us Most

Living with chronic pain often comes with uncertainty. Choosing the right pain management provider
starts with understanding your options. At Advanced Pain Medical Group, we believe informed patients
make confident decisions about their care.

From treatment options to appointment expectations, patients naturally have questions before taking
the next step. These frequently asked questions address the topics we’re asked about most—so you can
feel more comfortable, prepared, and supported from your very first visit.

# Reposicionamento de Medicamentos com IA

**BrTxGNN** é uma plataforma de predição de reposicionamento de medicamentos baseada no modelo TxGNN
de Harvard. Analisamos medicamentos registrados na ANVISA para identificar potenciais novas
indicações terapêuticas.

Usando inteligência artificial para descobrir novos usos para medicamentos existentes, acelerando a
pesquisa e desenvolvimento de tratamentos.

## O que é Reposicionamento de Medicamentos?

**Reposicionamento de medicamentos (Drug Repurposing)** é a descoberta de novas indicações
terapêuticas para medicamentos já aprovados. Esta abordagem reduz significativamente o tempo e custo
de desenvolvimento comparado ao desenvolvimento de novos medicamentos.

────────────────────────┬──────────────────────┬───────────────────
Comparação              │Novo Medicamento      │Reposicionamento   
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Tempo de desenvolvimento│10-15 anos            │3-5 anos           
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Custo estimado          │US$ 1-2 bilhões       │US$ 100-300 milhões
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Dados de segurança      │Necessário estabelecer│Já disponíveis     
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Risco de falha          │Muito alto (>90%)     │Menor              
────────────────────────┴──────────────────────┴───────────────────

## Fontes de Dados

A plataforma integra múltiplas fontes de dados públicas autorizadas para garantir a rastreabilidade
e valor acadêmico das previsões.

────────────────┬───────────────────────┬────────────────────
Tipo de Dados   │Fonte                  │Descrição           
────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────
Previsão IA     │[TxGNN][16]            │Modelo de Harvard   
────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────
Ensaios Clínicos│[ClinicalTrials.gov][17│Registro global     
                │]                      │                    
────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────
Literatura      │[PubMed][18]           │Base biomédica      
────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────
Medicamentos    │[DrugBank][19]         │Base de medicamentos
────────────────┼───────────────────────┼────────────────────
Registro Brasil │[ANVISA][20]           │Dados abertos ANVISA
────────────────┴───────────────────────┴────────────────────

## Sobre o TxGNN

[TxGNN][21] é um modelo de aprendizado profundo desenvolvido pelo Zitnik Lab da Harvard Medical
School, publicado na *Nature Medicine*. É o primeiro modelo fundamental projetado para
reposicionamento de medicamentos centrado no clínico.

> "TxGNN integra um grafo de conhecimento com 17.080 entidades biomédicas, usando redes neurais de
> grafos para aprender relações complexas entre nós, podendo prever a eficácia potencial de
> medicamentos para doenças raras." — Huang et al., Nature Medicine (2023)

# Reposicionamento de Medicamentos com IA

**BrTxGNN** é uma plataforma de predição de reposicionamento de medicamentos baseada no modelo TxGNN
de Harvard. Analisamos medicamentos registrados na ANVISA para identificar potenciais novas
indicações terapêuticas.

Usando inteligência artificial para descobrir novos usos para medicamentos existentes, acelerando a
pesquisa e desenvolvimento de tratamentos.

## O que é Reposicionamento de Medicamentos?

**Reposicionamento de medicamentos (Drug Repurposing)** é a descoberta de novas indicações
terapêuticas para medicamentos já aprovados. Esta abordagem reduz significativamente o tempo e custo
de desenvolvimento comparado ao desenvolvimento de novos medicamentos.

────────────────────────┬──────────────────────┬───────────────────
Comparação              │Novo Medicamento      │Reposicionamento   
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Tempo de desenvolvimento│10-15 anos            │3-5 anos           
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Custo estimado          │US$ 1-2 bilhões       │US$ 100-300 milhões
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Dados de segurança      │Necessário estabelecer│Já disponíveis     
────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┼───────────────────
Risco de falha          │Muito alto (>90%)     │Menor              
────────────────────────┴──────────────────────┴───────────────────

## Sobre o TxGNN

[TxGNN][21] é um modelo de aprendizado profundo desenvolvido pelo Zitnik Lab da Harvard Medical
School, publicado na *Nature Medicine*. É o primeiro modelo fundamental projetado para
reposicionamento de medicamentos centrado no clínico.

> "TxGNN integra um grafo de conhecimento com 17.080 entidades biomédicas, usando redes neurais de
> grafos para aprender relações complexas entre nós, podendo prever a eficácia potencial de
> medicamentos para doenças raras." — Huang et al., Nature Medicine (2023)

service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

# Invest Intelligently with the Most Powerful Stock Analysis Tool

FAST Graphs is a stock analysis software built for rational, long-term investors. It transforms
financial data into visual insights so you can see what a company is truly worth.

[Get Started][13][Historical performance graph of Amgen Inc showing stock price, adjusted earnings,
dividends, and financial metrics from 2005 to 2026 with key statistics and analyst scorecard
details.]
“A stock is not just a ticker symbol or an electronic blip; it is an ownership interest in an actual
business, with an underlying value that does not depend on its share price.”
Benjamin Graham
(American economist and financial investor)
Research terminal

# Where Intelligent
# Investing Begins

Analyze, compare, and understand any company with precision. Combine powerful visualization with
deep financial data to help you uncover the real value of every stock you study.

# Fundamentals First

FAST Graphs brings investing back to its foundation: owning a business, not a stock. Each chart
begins with the company’s fundamental strength and growth, then adds price so you can see whether
the market is being sensible or speculative.

[Line chart showing stock price, dividends, and earnings from 2005 to 2027 with the orange line
representing earnings as the engine of company value.]

# Decide if it’s worth investing in

All of these questions can be answered quickly just by looking at FAST Graphs. Figure out if you are
overpaying for a stock, or investing in a company that isn’t growing fast enough to meet your goals
and needs.

[Three charts illustrating stock valuation: undervalued with black line below orange line, fairly
valued with black line near orange line, and overvalued with black line above orange line.]

# Forecast With Reason, Not Emotion

View analyst expectations directly on the chart to see how future performance could affect
valuation. FAST Graphs helps you separate optimism from realism so you can invest with discipline
and confidence in your long-term convictions.

[Stock price chart showing correlation with adjusted operating earnings from 2024 to 2027, ending
with a closing price of USD 339.88 and a P/E of 15.00 on Dec 31, 2027, along with detailed rate of
return metrics and earnings projections.]

# Turn Fundamentals Into Clear Insight

Visualize how earnings, cash flow, and sales connect to long-term market value. Switch between
valuation metrics to test how the market has rewarded or punished performance and identify where
opportunity may lie.

[Four line charts showing upward trends in Adjusted Operating Earnings, Operating Cash Flow (OCF,
FFO), EBITDA, and Sales with shaded forecast areas.]

# **A clearer way to evaluate a company’s financial fundamentals**

The FG Score™ distills a company’s most important financial fundamentals into a single, easy to
understand score so you can quickly assess business quality without losing depth or transparency.
By organizing dozens of financial metrics into a structured, rules based framework, FG Score helps
you focus on what matters most. Instead of sorting through pages of raw data, you can immediately
see where a company is strong, where it may be weaker, and how balanced its overall financial
profile really is.

[Stock price chart showing correlation with adjusted operating earnings from 2024 to 2027, ending
with a closing price of USD 339.88 and a P/E of 15.00 on Dec 31, 2027, along with detailed rate of
return metrics and earnings projections.]

# Create your free account

FAST Graphs helps investors think in decades, not days. By visualizing fundamentals, valuation, and
performance together, it brings reason back to the investing process. Whether you are studying a
company’s history or projecting its future, FAST Graphs turns data into understanding and
understanding into disciplined decision making.

[GET STARTED][14]
screening tool

# Smarter Decisions

# Prebuilt Screens

discover quality opportunities immediately, without needing to build from scratch.

# Invest Intelligently with the Most Powerful Stock Analysis Tool

FAST Graphs is a stock analysis software built for rational, long-term investors. It transforms
financial data into visual insights so you can see what a company is truly worth.

[Get Started][13][Historical performance graph of Amgen Inc showing stock price, adjusted earnings,

details.]
“A stock is not just a ticker symbol or an electronic blip; it is an ownership interest in an actual
business, with an underlying value that does not depend on its share price.”
Benjamin Graham
(American economist and financial investor)
Research terminal

# Where Intelligent
# Investing Begins

Analyze, compare, and understand any company with precision. Combine powerful visualization with
deep financial data to help you uncover the real value of every stock you study.

# Fundamentals First

FAST Graphs brings investing back to its foundation: owning a business, not a stock. Each chart
begins with the company’s fundamental strength and growth, then adds price so you can see whether
the market is being sensible or speculative.

[Line chart showing stock price, dividends, and earnings from 2005 to 2027 with the orange line
representing earnings as the engine of company value.]

# Decide if it’s worth investing in

All of these questions can be answered quickly just by looking at FAST Graphs. Figure out if you are
overpaying for a stock, or investing in a company that isn’t growing fast enough to meet your goals
and needs.

[Three charts illustrating stock valuation: undervalued with black line below orange line, fairly
valued with black line near orange line, and overvalued with black line above orange line.]

# Forecast With Reason, Not Emotion

View analyst expectations directly on the chart to see how future performance could affect
valuation. FAST Graphs helps you separate optimism from realism so you can invest with discipline
and confidence in your long-term convictions.

[Stock price chart showing correlation with adjusted operating earnings from 2024 to 2027, ending
with a closing price of USD 339.88 and a P/E of 15.00 on Dec 31, 2027, along with detailed rate of
return metrics and earnings projections.]

# Turn Fundamentals Into Clear Insight

Visualize how earnings, cash flow, and sales connect to long-term market value. Switch between
valuation metrics to test how the market has rewarded or punished performance and identify where
opportunity may lie.

[Four line charts showing upward trends in Adjusted Operating Earnings, Operating Cash Flow (OCF,
FFO), EBITDA, and Sales with shaded forecast areas.]

# **A clearer way to evaluate a company’s financial fundamentals**

The FG Score™ distills a company’s most important financial fundamentals into a single, easy to
understand score so you can quickly assess business quality without losing depth or transparency.
By organizing dozens of financial metrics into a structured, rules based framework, FG Score helps
you focus on what matters most. Instead of sorting through pages of raw data, you can immediately
see where a company is strong, where it may be weaker, and how balanced its overall financial
profile really is.

[Stock price chart showing correlation with adjusted operating earnings from 2024 to 2027, ending
with a closing price of USD 339.88 and a P/E of 15.00 on Dec 31, 2027, along with detailed rate of
return metrics and earnings projections.]

# Create your free account

FAST Graphs helps investors think in decades, not days. By visualizing fundamentals, valuation, and
performance together, it brings reason back to the investing process. Whether you are studying a
company’s history or projecting its future, FAST Graphs turns data into understanding and
understanding into disciplined decision making.

[GET STARTED][14]

# Smarter Decisions

discover quality opportunities immediately, without needing to build from scratch.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge

# Welcome To Synera Dental Wellness

A unique dental center in New York City, focused on providing comprehensive and customized
treatments for TMJ disorders, Airway issues including snoring and obstructive sleep apnea,
orthodontics, myofunctional therapy, and release of tongue and lip ties.

[ book appointment ][39]

Learn More
[White downward arrow on black]

## Your Path to Integrated Oral and Overall Health

We understand that your mouth, jaw, and airway are intricately connected and play a vital role in
your overall health and well-being. That’s why we take a **physiologic and health-focused
approach**, looking beyond individual symptoms to identify and address the **root causes** of your
concerns.

[ About Synera ][42]
[Patient relaxed in dental chair.]
Where Your Smile, Jaw, and Airway Work in Harmony
[Sugar cubes arranged as a tooth]

## Our Comprehensive Treatments Include

[

#### Infant Tethered Oral Tissues

Gentle laser treatment combined with myofunctional therapy for improved function and development.

][43] [

#### Early Orthodontic Intervention

Proactive treatments starting as early as age 3 to guide healthy jaw and facial development.

][44] [

#### Early Sleep Issues

Addressing snoring, mouth breathing, and restless sleep in children through myofunctional therapy,
functional appliances, and tethered tissue treatment.

][45] [

#### Expansion

Utilizing various techniques, including functional appliances, orthodontics, and skeletal expanders,
to create optimal space for breathing and tooth alignment at any age.

][46] [

#### TMJ Disorders (TMD)

Comprehensive evaluation and customized treatments including oral orthotics, therapeutic injections
(Botox/Xeomin), exercises, and laser therapy to alleviate pain and dysfunction.

][47] [

#### Therapeutic Injections

Targeted Botulinum toxin injections for bruxism, orofacial pain, and trigger point relief.

][48] [

#### Sleep & Airway Solutions

Custom oral appliances, myofunctional therapy (including tongue-tie release), laser treatments, and
orthodontic/expansion therapies to improve breathing and sleep quality.

][49] [

#### Tongue-Tie Release

Laser procedures combined with essential myofunctional therapy to address restrictions impacting
function and development at any age.

][50] [

#### Orthodontics

A wide range of options from early intervention to adult treatment, including traditional braces
(metal, clear, white), custom 3D printed braces, clear aligners (for kids and adults), and various
expansion appliances. All our orthodontic treatments whether for aesthetics, health, or symptoms,
are designed to optimize the airway and TMJ. 

][51] [

#### General Dental Procedures

While our focus is on specialized care, we happily collaborate with your general dentist for all
your routine dental needs.

][52]
Comprehensive Care for All Ages and Needs

#### Synera Dental Wellness provides expert evaluation and treatment for patients of all ages

#### 01

###### Infants

Addressing tethered oral tissues (tongue-tie, lip-tie, buccal-tie) with laser precision and
integrated myofunctional therapy for optimal outcomes.

[Black and white vertical lines pattern]

###### Children

Early orthodontic and myofunctional interventions to guide healthy growth and development,
potentially minimizing the need for extensive future orthodontics and addressing early sleep issues

[Black and white vertical lines pattern]

#### 03

###### Adults

Comprehensive solutions for TMJ disorders, sleep-disordered breathing, and orthodontic needs,
including skeletal expansion, custom orthotics, and appliances. Myofunctional therapy, tongue and
lip tie release, to improve health and aesthetics at any age.
